svg.text: The components behind a Composer conversion
Component relationships · Not execution order · Each numbered component can be expanded later
SNAPIR CONVERTER · logical modules and persistent stores
Collects source, scope, model and runtime settings
Accepts start, resume and approval commands
Key variable name only; never its secret value
Discovers projects, Java, XML and classpath
Selects root operations and source scope
Requests mapping and verifies source fingerprints
Supplies pinned source evidence to conversion
Parses Composer XML and related Java AST
Links operations, formats, classes and OpSteps
Generates a map or uses verified existing data
Indexed Composer map and dependency records
Source hashes and reusable parsed analysis
Rebuildable when missing or out of date
Chooses source, reusable JAR or operation API
Applies gates, checkpoints, retries and resume
Converts base components and configured units
Assembles native operation flow + HTTP clients
Separates Java, API metadata and test stages
Creates AI tests, shared fixtures and mocks
Manages model attempts and correction feedback
Configured model API, reached through LiteLLM
Generates code, metadata, tests and mocks
API key supplied through the environment
JDK + Maven compilation and executed JUnit
XML format comparison with tests / mocks
API, settings, source and artifact checks
Advisory mutation tests and AI review
Wraps native code as Spring Boot microservices
Includes shared JARs, test assets and settings
Generates values.yaml and validated Helm charts
Reports, logs, manifests and validation evidence
Converted source, typed APIs and compiled JARs
Pinned versions, manifests and integrity hashes
Supports reuse and recovery across runs
Converted operation HTTP contracts and paths
Describes callable services; does not deploy them
Dependency pins, accepted results and evidence
All conversion modules persist progress here
User publishes images and deploys services
Microservices use internal OpenShift Service DNS
Cyan: requests and returned results · Purple: persistent reads / writes · Gray: external systems · Amber: manual deployment
SQLite is used by all conversion modules; representative relationships are shown. These boxes are logical modules, not separate deployed services.
Default policy: fact collection / validation OFF; source / AST analysis ON; AI-generated tests and mocks ON; shared reuse and full packaging ON.
Runtime URLs: standalone → external address; microservice → internal OpenShift Service DNS. Deployment remains a user action.
